reviewer: Codex visual inspection of opened Godot renders
scope: Final deployed exports; acceptance for current gameplay camera and hardware, not concept-exact or artist-authored joint topology. Findings preserve known limitations.

models.animation_review: Every exported clip sampled at 0%, 25%, 50% and 75%; actual gameplay motion tested separately.
models.finding: Bay horse front/side/back/three-quarter and all four gait clips opened. Black tail and lower legs remodeled; isolated rider and fitted saddle/mounted angles opened. Actual stirrup error below 7 mm and rein error below 1 mm. Lower legs are simpler than the native coat.
Four angles inspected for silhouette, metric scale, material response and defining structures; clean construction or shared reconstruction lineage is disclosed in the catalogue.
